subject: Offer: Senior Inference Engineer — package review & onboarding window
content:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Anita Patel <anita.patel@gmail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Offer: Senior Inference Engineer — package review & onboarding window

Hi Anita —

Congratulations again — we're excited to extend an offer for the Senior Inference Engineer role on the Infra/Serving team. Attached is the draft offer letter (Offer_Senior_Inference_Engineer_v1.pdf) that outlines compensation, equity, and the onboarding package. A few quick notes up front:

- Base salary: $230,000 (annual)
- Equity: 0.50% RSU grant (4-year vest; 1-yr cliff)
- Relocation stipend: $8,000 (payable after start)
- Standard benefits and 15 days PTO year 1

We would like to schedule a 30-minute offer call this week to walk through the package and answer any questions before you review the DocuSign envelope. Are you available for any of these slots (all PST)?
- Mon 11/9 10:00–10:30 AM
- Mon 11/9 3:30–4:00 PM
- Tue 11/10 9:00–9:30 AM

If none of those work, tell me three times that do and we'll accommodate. Also please let me know your preferred start window (earliest possible start date + any constraints around notice periods/visa timing).

I've cc'd Laura (HR) and Monica (hiring manager) so we can coordinate the onboarding logistics. If you're comfortable with the draft we can push the DocuSign link and aim to have the final signed by mid-November.

Attachments: Offer_Senior_Inference_Engineer_v1.pdf (draft)

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

----

From: Anita Patel <anita.patel@gmail.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@startupx.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 12:40:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Offer: Senior Inference Engineer — package review & onboarding window

Hi Rishi —

Thank you so much — really excited about the role and the team. I reviewed the attached and have a couple of questions/requests before a formal signing:

1) Start date: I can be available earlier than I mentioned in interviews; earliest practical start for me would be Dec 1 (I have a two-week notice but could negotiate to Dec 1). Would you be able to support a Dec 1 or Dec 6 start?

2) Relocation payout timing: the letter says "payable after start" — would Redwood be open to paying the relocation stipend within 30 days of start instead of waiting until payroll cycles later? This helps me with movers' deposits.

3) Vacation accrual wording: the current wording is a little unclear around prorated PTO. Can we add explicit language that year-1 accrual is prorated by start date?

4) Equity cliff & vesting: I wanted confirmation that the standard cliff is 1 year and that the equity grant date will be the start date. Could we clarify whether the company would consider a 6-month partial acceleration in the event of a role elimination?

I've attached a redline with a few suggested edits to the language (Offer_Senior_Inference_Engineer_v1_redlines.pdf). Happy to discuss on the offer call — I can do Mon 11/9 at 3:30 PM PST.

Thanks again,
Anita Patel
(anita.patel@gmail.com)

----

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Anita Patel — redlines and start date request

Laura/Monica/Marissa —

Forwarding Anita's reply and her redlines. Anita is available Mon 11/9 at 3:30 PM PST for a 30-minute call; she is requesting an earlier start (Dec 1 or Dec 6), a relocation payout within 30 days, a clarified PTO prorating sentence, and clarification on the equity cliff/partial acceleration.

Quick recs from my side:
- Start date: Dec 6 is likely safest given notice period; if manager and hiring team are aligned we can target Dec 6.
- Relocation: I think we can approve paying the stipend within 30 days — we should confirm with payroll.
- PTO wording: small edit to clarify prorate — low risk.
- Equity acceleration: legal will need to weigh in on partial acceleration language; historically we don't commit to acceleration except in M&A/termination clauses but we can offer language that describes existing policy.

Monica, could you confirm whether Dec 1 is feasible on your end and whether you'd be comfortable with the relocation payout timeline? Laura, can you run the redline and proposed language by payroll and legal and see what we're comfortable committing to in the offer letter?

Thanks — if you want to jump on a 15-min sync before the call at 2:45 PM PST I can join.

Best,
Rishi

----

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Anita Patel <anita.patel@gmail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Offer update & DocuSign — Senior Inference Engineer

Hi Anita —

Thanks for the thoughtful notes and for sending the redline. We reviewed your requests with the hiring team, payroll, and legal. We can accommodate the following updates and would like to confirm next steps:

- Start date: We can confirm a Dec 6, 2026 start (please give your current employer the Dec 6 date when you provide notice).
- Relocation: Redwood will pay the $8,000 relocation stipend within 30 days of your start date.
- PTO accrual: We've updated the offer to state: "Vacation for year 1 will be prorated based on your start date; accrual will begin on your first day of employment."
- Equity: Standard 4-year vesting with a 1-year cliff; we cannot offer guaranteed partial acceleration outside of specific change-in-control or termination scenarios. We have added the clarifying sentence: "Vesting is subject to the terms of the RSU agreement and Redwood's equity plan; acceleration outside plan terms is not guaranteed."

Attached is the updated offer (Offer_Senior_Inference_Engineer_v1.1.pdf) reflecting the changes above. To finalize, please review and sign via the DocuSign envelope here: https://docusign.com/envelope/abcdef12345. We ask that you sign by COB Mon, Nov 16 so we can provision equipment and start the background check process.

If you want to chat before signing, I am available Tue 11/10 at 4:00 PM PST; otherwise Rishi will join your 3:30 PM PST call tomorrow to walk through details.

Attachments: Offer_Senior_Inference_Engineer_v1.1.pdf

Welcome — we look forward to having you on the team.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0188
